title: Melania Trump ready to continue humanitarian efforts in Ukraine after Oleshky operation, senior adviser says
summary: U.S. First Lady Melania Trump is ready to continue her humanitarian efforts in Ukraine if President Volodymyr Zelensky and Russian President Vladimir Putin are willing to continue cooperating with her after the operation in Oleshky concludes.

title: Russian attack on energy facility in Chernivtsi region causes power outages
summary: In the Chernivtsi region, a power facility was damaged when debris from a Russian military jet-powered drone fell, causing a power outage for consumers.

title: Ukraine to implement ceasefire in Oleshky area from midnight on October 27
summary: Starting at 3:00 a.m. on October 27, Kyiv time, Ukraine is implementing a ceasefire in a designated area to conduct a humanitarian operation in the temporarily occupied town of Oleshky in the Kherson region.

title: Russian strike on Kharkiv kills and injures civilians
summary: Russian invaders launched strikes on the Novobavarskyi district of Kharkiv this evening, killing two people and wounding four others.

title: Zelensky and Estonian president discuss achieving peace in Ukraine
summary: President Volodymyr Zelensky discussed with the newly elected President of Estonia, Ülle Madise, the issue of achieving peace in Ukraine and emphasized the importance of Europe’s participation in peace talks.

title: Zelensky meets Lithuanian Seimas speaker to discuss Ukraine’s European integration
summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky and Seimas Speaker Juozas Olekas of the Republic of Lithuania discussed Ukraine’s European integration and the priorities of Lithuania’s presidency of the Council of the EU in the first half of 2027.

title: UN calls Russian attacks on Ukraine’s energy infrastructure crimes against humanity
summary: The Russian authorities have committed crimes against humanity by attacking Ukraine’s energy infrastructure and recruiting foreign nationals to participate in hostilities on the side of their armed forces in Ukraine, the UN Commission stated.

title: Zelensky discusses military cooperation and joint projects with Moldova's PM
summary: President Volodymyr Zelensky held a meeting with Moldovan Prime Minister Vasile Tofan, during which they discussed security issues, including Transnistria, European integration, and the strengthening of military cooperation between the two countries.
